title: Set admin login password to SC05GOJRI

requirements.summary: Update the hardcoded admin password in the useAdminAuth hook to 'SC05GOJRI'
acceptanceCriteria: Entering 'SC05GOJRI' in the admin login modal successfully authenticates and grants admin access.
Entering any other password shows an error and denies access.
No other functionality or UI is changed.

file_operations.description: Update the ADMIN_PASSWORD constant value from its current value to 'SC05GOJRI'. This is a simple string replacement in the constant declaration. Do not modify any other logic, function signatures, or state management in the hook.
